Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Construction laborers annual median?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Construction Laborers ($60,890). Among metros with a published median: Chicago $60,890, Seattle $59,740, Austin $44,000. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Construction laborers?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Construction Laborers (26,690 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 26,690, Seattle 13,040, Austin 11,140. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Construction laborers most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Austin has the highest published location quotient (1.22). Published LQs: Austin 1.22, Seattle 0.89, Chicago 0.84.

What is the hourly median for Construction laborers in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $21.16; Chicago $29.27; Seattle $28.72. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
